mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT c.CALENDER_NO AS scheduleNo, TO_CHAR(c.CALENDER_NO) AS calendarId, c.TITLE AS title, c.CONTENT AS content, TO_CHAR(c.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS startDate, TO_CHAR(c.START_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS startTime, TO_CHAR(c.END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS endDate, TO_CHAR(c.END_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS endTime, c.CATEGORY AS category, c.FAVORITE_YN AS favoriteYn, c.DISCLOSURE_STATUS AS disclosureStatus FROM CALENDER c INNER JOIN CALENDERCONNECTION cc ON c.CALENDER_NO = cc.CALENDER_NO WHERE cc.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND NVL(c.IS_DELETED, 'N') = 'N' AND c.START_DATE < ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{yearMonth}, 'YYYYMM'), 1) AND c.END_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{yearMonth}, 'YYYYMM') ORDER BY startDate, startTime

SELECT DISTINCT c.CALENDER_NO AS scheduleNo, TO_CHAR(c.CALENDER_NO) AS calendarId, c.TITLE AS title, c.CONTENT AS content, TO_CHAR(c.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS startDate, TO_CHAR(c.START_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS startTime, TO_CHAR(c.END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS endDate, TO_CHAR(c.END_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS endTime, c.CATEGORY AS category, c.FAVORITE_YN AS favoriteYn, c.DISCLOSURE_STATUS AS disclosureStatus FROM CALENDER c INNER JOIN CALENDERCONNECTION cc ON c.CALENDER_NO = cc.CALENDER_NO WHERE cc.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND NVL(c.IS_DELETED, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY startDate, startTime

SELECT DISTINCT c.CALENDER_NO AS scheduleNo, TO_CHAR(c.CALENDER_NO) AS calendarId, c.TITLE AS title, c.CONTENT AS content, TO_CHAR(c.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS startDate, TO_CHAR(c.START_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS startTime, TO_CHAR(c.END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS endDate, TO_CHAR(c.END_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS endTime, c.CATEGORY AS category, c.FAVORITE_YN AS favoriteYn, u.USER_NO AS userNo, u.USER_NAME AS userName FROM CALENDER c INNER JOIN CALENDERCONNECTION cc ON c.CALENDER_NO = cc.CALENDER_NO INNER JOIN USERS u ON cc.USER_NO = u.USER_NO WHERE u.COMPANY_NO = #{companyNo} AND NVL(c.IS_DELETED, 'N') = 'N' AND c.START_DATE < TO_DATE(#{date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 AND c.END_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY u.USER_NO, startTime

SELECT c.CALENDER_NO AS scheduleNo, TO_CHAR(c.CALENDER_NO) AS calendarId, c.TITLE AS title, TO_CHAR(c.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS startDate, TO_CHAR(c.START_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS startTime, TO_CHAR(c.END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS endDate, TO_CHAR(c.END_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS endTime, c.CATEGORY AS category, c.FAVORITE_YN AS favoriteYn, c.DISCLOSURE_STATUS AS disclosureStatus FROM CALENDER c WHERE c.CALENDER_NO = #{calendarId} AND NVL(c.IS_DELETED, 'N') = 'N'

SELECT c.CALENDER_NO AS scheduleNo, TO_CHAR(c.CALENDER_NO) AS calendarId, c.TITLE AS title, c.CONTENT AS content, TO_CHAR(c.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS startDate, TO_CHAR(c.START_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS startTime, TO_CHAR(c.END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS endDate, TO_CHAR(c.END_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS endTime, c.CATEGORY AS category, c.FAVORITE_YN AS favoriteYn, u.USER_NO AS userNo, u.USER_NAME AS userName FROM CALENDER c LEFT JOIN CALENDERCONNECTION cc ON c.CALENDER_NO = cc.CALENDER_NO LEFT JOIN USERS u ON cc.USER_NO = u.USER_NO WHERE c.CALENDER_NO = #{calendarId} AND NVL(c.IS_DELETED, 'N') = 'N'
mapper.insert:
SELECT 'CAL_' || LPAD(SEQ_CALENDER_NO.NEXTVAL, 6, '0') FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO CALENDER ( CALENDER_NO, TITLE, CONTENT, START_DATE, END_DATE, CATEGORY, FAVORITE_YN, IS_DELETED ) VALUES ( #{scheduleNo}, #{title, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{content, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_DATE(#{startDate} || ' ' || NVL(#{startTime}, '00:00'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), TO_DATE(#{endDate} || ' ' || NVL(#{endTime}, '23:59'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), #{category, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N', 'N' )
mapper.update: UPDATE CALENDER SET TITLE = #{title, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CONTENT = #{content, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, START_DATE = TO_DATE(#{startDate} || ' ' || NVL(#{startTime}, '00:00'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), END_DATE = TO_DATE(#{endDate} || ' ' || NVL(#{endTime}, '23:59'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), CATEGORY = #{category, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE CALENDER_NO = #{scheduleNo}
